rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, proj_w=5, proj_kernel=5, bf_d_w_ratio=0.16666666666666666, manduca_N0=100000.0, manduca_bowtie=True, img_n_bf=6, img_kernel=9, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.05, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-13 manduca_bilateral breast (train_n=400, val=200). SIX-BOX from BEST (iter-8 hr=0.2771): (1) PRIOR: ceiling hr=0.2771 (iter-8). lr 1e-3 (iter-12) REGRESSED to 0.2353 -> lr=5e-3 optimal. All SCALAR levers mapped (img_sr peak 0.05, img_n_bf sat@6, img_kernel 9, img spatial 0.5, epochs inert, proj_n_bf worse, proj_sr flat, lr optimal). The TRAINABLE BOWTIE (manduca_bowtie, per-detector log-N0 profile) is the one UNTESTED architectural DOF -- makes the Manduca noise model per-ray instead of scalar-N0. (2) FAILURE MODE: scalar-N0 assumes uniform incident flux across detectors; if the breast sinogram has per-detector-column intensity structure, a single N0 mis-stabilizes per-ray variance, leaving the proj-bilateral's noise-adaptivity mistuned column-wise. (3) ONE KNOB: manduca_bowtie False -> True (from iter-8 best; +n_det=1024 params, init zero = identical to scalar at step 0). Architecturally-distinct DOF. (4) HYPOTHESIS: bowtie=True lifts hr above 0.2771 because a learnable per-detector blank-scan profile lets the sqrt/Anscombe variance stabilization adapt per ray, so the proj-bilateral becomes genuinely noise-adaptive column-wise (the paper's per-ray mechanism). FALSIFIER: if flat (proj-domain already inert), the bowtie is cosmetic -> proj-domain conclusively exhausted, remaining iters consolidate the best config. (5) BUDGET: +1024 params but same forward cost (one broadcast add); ~500s, under 20-min. params_M ~1e-3. (6) Loop continues; iter-14 on landing. turbo, save ckpt+recon, params_M logged.
